intro: Qatar is a low, flat desert peninsula jutting into the Gulf, about 160 km long.

chapters.title: Desert and sea
text: Most of Qatar is stony desert with some sand dunes in the south. Khor Al Adaid, the 'Inland Sea', is a tidal bay surrounded by dunes on the Saudi border.
Its only land border is with Saudi Arabia.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Summers are extremely hot and humid; winters are mild. The World Cup was moved to November and December to avoid the heat.

keyTerms.meaning: Land surrounded by water on three sides.
